title: Width series: hidden size d swept at fixed depth, vocabulary, and compute
purpose: Test the a-priori sizing heuristic d >~ K_eff (K_eff = 240 reachable policy actions). Only d_model varies; n_layer, vocab, tokenizer, pretraining steps, SFT recipe, seeds, and the evaluation split are frozen to the clean grid used in the companion IoTJ paper.

fixed.n_head_rule: d_model / 64 (head_dim 64); d=224 uses 4 heads (head_dim 56, even as RoPE requires)
fixed.sft_train: backend/models/compact_llm/datasets/keff_series/K240/train_100.jsonl (policy-only + coverage_fill, 49,093 rows; no teacher-labelled natural rows)
fixed.eval_segment: rule (2,000 rows, every one of the 240 reachable tuples covered >= 2x, no input with conflicting gold tuples)

W384.note: identical to clean-grid 23M and to the deployed CompactLM

preregistered_predictions.status: FROZEN at first launch: sha256 recorded in backend/reports/scale_grid_width/width_series.inputs.sha256
preregistered_predictions.P-W1: Rule-segment coarse compliance rises steeply from W128 to W256 and the largest single step lies at the d crossing of K_eff (W224 -> W256).
preregistered_predictions.P-W2: From W256 upward, each additional step gains less than the W224 -> W256 step on coarse compliance (diminishing returns above K_eff).
preregistered_predictions.P-W3: W192 and W384 share backbone config with the IoTJ clean-grid 8M and 23M cells but are fine-tuned on policy-only + coverage-fill data instead of the train_100 mixture; their rule-segment scores are expected to be at or above the IoTJ Gen-Policy 23M value (49.3% strict / 78.8% coarse for W384). This is a plausibility check, not a confirmatory prediction.
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Per-seed exact McNemar on the 2,000 paired test rows for adjacent widths, signed z combined by Stouffer, Holm over the 6 adjacent contrasts x 2 metrics; adopt only if Holm p < 0.05 and all three seeds share the sign.

notes: Depth and d_ff ratio are held constant so this series isolates width; compare with the companion depth series (config/depth_series.json, to be written).
Pretraining steps are compute-matched by step count, not by tokens seen per parameter; wider models are therefore not trained to convergence. Report loss curves in the appendix.
Scale names must not contain '_' (tools/summarize_scale_grid.py parses compactlm_<scale>_f<fraction>_s<seed>).
Changed 2026-09-04 before launch: SFT data switched from scale_grid_subsets/train_100 to keff_series/K240 so that W and K series form one grid.
role_in_k_series: This series is the K_eff = 240 column of the K series (config/keff_policies.json); K48/K480/K960 reuse its pretrain checkpoints and its d grid subset {128,192,256,384,512}.
